Backend: 7 NEW thumb/raw-batch tests pass + 50 regression tests pass = 57/58 (1 PM-scope test skipped because Chris Wright is admin/legacy bypass). The supervisor_notes regression flagged in iter45 was intentional per user direction — the iter42 test was updated to assert leadership CAN now create supervisor_notes (test_supervisor_notes_allowed_for_leadership) and it passes. Frontend (Playwright on desktop 1920x1080): Hub DOM order verified [field, qc, safety, leadership, pm, shop, training, projects, admin] — Leadership tile is immediately AFTER Safety with slate class, Projects tile is LAST after Training Hub. minor.issue: INFRASTRUCTURE NOTE: the Cloudflare/preview edge proxy rewrites the response Cache-Control header from origin's 'private, max-age=86400, immutable' to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' — verified by curl-ing localhost:8001 (correct header) vs the public URL (rewritten). This nullifies the browser-level caching benefit of /thumb in the preview environment. Production may have the same issue depending on the deployed edge configuration. Action item for main agent: confirm Cloudflare Page/Cache rules on mascidocs.com do NOT strip /api/job-photos/*/thumb cache headers; consider serving thumbs from a static-style path or adding a Vary header that the edge respects. The architectural improvements (Pillow downscale, 200 status, image/jpeg, payload ≤25 KB, IntersectionObserver lazy-load on the frontend) are still active and meaningful even without the cache header.

action_items: [INFRASTRUCTURE — non-blocking for code] Confirm production CDN/edge does not strip the Cache-Control header on /api/job-photos/*/thumb. The origin returns 'private, max-age=86400, immutable' correctly; only the preview edge proxy is rewriting it.
(Optional) Add data-testid='training-leadership-signin' on the Sign In button in TrainingTrack AccessDenied for cleaner regression.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/job-photos/{id}/thumb implementation is solid: Pillow LANCZOS thumbnail to 360px, JPEG q60 + optimize, RGB conversion for RGBA/LA/P modes, graceful fallback to original bytes when Pillow chokes (heic/heif), proper PM-scope check, 404 on missing.
/api/job-photos/raw-batch correctly caps at 50 ids, drops out-of-scope silently (no information leak), returns empty list on empty input — ideal lightbox preloader API.

Hub.jsx ordering is exactly per spec: leadership immediately after safety, projects last after training. The slate accent on Field Leadership is visible and visually consistent with the Training Hub leadership tile.

TrainingTrack.jsx leadership gate works correctly — without token it shows the dedicated 'This track is password-protected · Sign in as Field Leadership' AccessDenied with a SIGN IN button that resolves to /leadership (not /admin/login).

Lesson 3 ('leadership-03-recognition-equipment-evaluations') was rewritten as required: contains references to Equipment Return, 31-item catalog, 9 manufacturers, 2-photo minimum, auto-flag damage, and serial-lookup workflow.

rca of the issue: Cache-Control rewrite RCA: curl http://localhost:8001/api/job-photos/<id>/thumb returns 'cache-control: private, max-age=86400, immutable' (correct). curl https://backup-forensics.preview.emergentagent.com/...same path returns 'cache-control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' with cf-ray header (Cloudflare edge). The override is at the edge layer (Cloudflare or Emergent's preview ingress), not the FastAPI route. No code change required if production CDN is configured to respect origin headers — only verification is needed.
